skill.name: happyhorse-1-0
skill.description: Use HappyHorse 1.0 through the RunComfy CLI to generate short text-to-video clips. The skill documents supported inputs, output handling, prompting guidance, and when to choose related RunComfy video models.
skill.summary: Generate short HappyHorse 1.0 videos through the RunComfy CLI.
skill.author: agentspace-so

security_audit.summary: The skill has expected external-command and network behavior because it runs the RunComfy CLI to submit video jobs. Most static hits are false positives from Markdown backticks and ellipsis in documentation, but CLI execution and bearer-token API submission remain confirmed risks. No evidence found of prompt injection text in the skill file.

remediation.issue: External CLI execution and installer commands
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user confirmation before installing or running npx, npm, or runcomfy commands, and display the exact arguments before execution.
Clearly disclose that prompts and bearer tokens are sent to RunComfy, recommend scoped tokens, and warn users not to submit sensitive prompts.
Document the token file path, expected permissions, token revocation steps, and the RUNCOMFY_TOKEN alternative for CI environments.
Keep the host allowlist and file-size cap, sanitize output filenames, and constrain downloads to the requested output directory.

content.value_statement: Video teams need a repeatable way to turn prompts into short AI videos. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through the HappyHorse 1.0 RunComfy workflow.
actual_capabilities: Invokes the HappyHorse 1.0 text-to-video endpoint through the RunComfy CLI.
Documents prompt, aspect ratio, resolution, duration, seed, and watermark inputs.
Supports 3 to 15 second clips at 720P or 1080P.
Provides prompt guidance for motion, camera framing, audio, and multi-shot consistency.
Explains output download behavior and RunComfy CLI exit codes.
Identifies when related RunComfy video models may be a better fit.
limitations: Requires a RunComfy account, CLI installation, and authentication token.
The included endpoint is text-to-video only and does not accept source video or external audio.
Clip duration is limited to 15 seconds.
Prompts and generated media metadata are sent to RunComfy infrastructure.

use_cases.title: Marketing Short Creation
use_cases.description: Create vertical or widescreen product clips with prompt guidance for motion, audio, and brand consistency.

use_cases.title: Prototype Video Concepts
use_cases.description: Test cinematic ideas before committing production time or agency budget.

use_cases.title: Multilingual Social Assets
use_cases.description: Draft short videos from supported-language prompts for campaign review.

prompt_templates.title: Generate a Basic Clip
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a default landscape video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use HappyHorse 1.0 to create a 5 second 1080P 16:9 video. Prompt: [describe the action, camera, setting, and audio]. Save outputs to [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Create a Vertical Short
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a social video.
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate an 8 second 9:16 HappyHorse video with no watermark. Prompt: [vertical scene with motion, camera, and ambient sound]. Save it to [folder].

prompt_templates.title: Compare Prompt Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Run two 3 second 720P HappyHorse tests with the same seed. Use these prompt variants: [variant A] and [variant B]. Summarize which result has better motion.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Multi-Shot Sequence
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for character consistency across shots.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a 12 second HappyHorse clip with two shots. Keep this character anchor consistent: [character]. Include camera, action, and audio for each shot.

output_examples.input: Generate a 5 second landscape clip of a courier crossing a rainy street at night.
output_examples.output: A RunComfy job is submitted for a 16:9 1080P HappyHorse clip. The output folder contains the generated video and result details.

output_examples.input: Create a vertical cafe ad with steam, morning light, and soft ambient sound.
output_examples.output: The skill prepares a 9:16 prompt, requests an 8 second video, disables the watermark, and saves the downloaded media to the chosen folder.

output_examples.input: Compare two short test prompts for a product reveal sequence.
output_examples.output: Two 720P test clips are generated with the same seed, followed by a concise comparison of motion quality and audio fit.

best_practices: Describe visible motion over time, not only the scene.
State camera framing, duration, aspect ratio, and audio direction before generation.
Use short 720P tests before requesting longer 1080P clips.
anti_patterns: Using prompts longer than the documented 2,500 character limit.
Combining too many unrelated actions in one short clip.
Requesting unsupported aspect ratios, external audio driving, or image-to-video input through this endpoint.

faq.question: Does this skill generate video locally?
faq.answer: No. It uses the RunComfy CLI and hosted HappyHorse 1.0 endpoint.

faq.question: What credentials are required?
faq.answer: A RunComfy login or RUNCOMFY_TOKEN is required before generation.

faq.question: Can I use source images or videos?
faq.answer: Not with this text-to-video endpoint. Use another pipeline for image-to-video or video editing.

faq.question: What video lengths are supported?
faq.answer: The documented duration range is 3 to 15 seconds.

faq.question: Where are generated files saved?
faq.answer: The CLI downloads allowed RunComfy output URLs into the output directory you choose.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: It is marked compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
